assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent full-body sprite for a dark science-fiction auto chess game. Primary request: ONE Axe Thrall, an agile humanoid psychic construct assassin made of angular black ceramic and emerald-turquoise armor, an enclosed pointed helmet with a tiny luminous visor, broad swept shoulder plates, slim waist, articulated armored legs and claw-like boots. It holds one long crescent-bladed throwing axe diagonally down beside the body, with a dark shaft and a bright jade energy edge; free hand slightly raised for balance. Original reinterpretation of an alien puppet warrior, not a human soldier, no exposed flesh. Semi-realistic painted 3D strategy miniature, readable crisp silhouette, three-quarter front view facing slightly right, full body including axe tip and both feet inside frame with generous margins. Neutral combat-ready stance suitable for animated leaning and slashing. Subtle bronze trims, upper-left lighting, coherent with a science-fantasy auto chess army. Actual transparent background, no scenery, no floor, no base, no cast shadow, no text, no UI, no logos, no other units.
